# Codes

This folder groups the standardized medical coding systems and specific code sets used by the Danish Atrial Fibrillation Database (AFDK) and the Regionernes Kliniske Kvalitetsudviklingsprogram (RKKP) to measure clinical quality and patient safety. It contains the exact ICD-10 diagnosis codes, ATC drug classifications, SKS intervention identifiers, laboratory test parameters, and echocardiography procedure codes required to extract data from national registries. By standardizing these identifiers, Danish health authorities can systematically track anticoagulant safety, monitor diagnostic workups, and evaluate cardiovascular care quality across all regions.

## Pages

- [[entities/codes/diagnosis-codes/index|Diagnosis Codes]] — ICD-10 codes tracking heart failure hospitalizations, ischemic stroke incidence, and severe bleeding events to monitor anticoagulant safety.
- [[entities/codes/drug-classes/index|Drug Classes]] — ATC classification codes identifying broad medication categories, such as vitamin K antagonists, to measure oral anticoagulant prevalence.
- [[entities/codes/intervention-codes/index|Intervention Codes]] — SKS codes capturing structured patient education and preventive care initiatives for atrial fibrillation and flutter patients.
- [[entities/codes/laboratory-tests/index|Laboratory Tests]] — Registry codes for thyrotropin (TSH) and creatinine measurements used to mandate diagnostic workups and annual kidney function monitoring.
- [[entities/codes/procedure-codes/index|Procedure Codes]] — National health register codes identifying various forms of echocardiography to evaluate evidence-based cardiovascular diagnostic practices.
